# Bundled third-party components

The complete archive includes these unmodified runtime packages for installation convenience:

- `net.openwg.gameface_1.2.2.wotmod` — OpenWG Gameface injector and wrappers, package ID `net.openwg.gameface`, version 1.2.2;
- `izeberg.modssettingsapi_1.7.1.wotmod` — ModsSettings API by IzeBerg, package ID `izeberg.modssettingsapi`, version 1.7.1;
- `me.poliroid.modslistapi_1.8.0.wotmod` — Modifications List API by poliroid, package ID `me.poliroid.modslistapi`, version 1.8.0.

These packages are redistributed without modification. Copyright, licensing, and ownership remain with their respective authors. `manifest.json` records the exact version and SHA-256 digest of every bundled file.
